content: Nganyang kwabba babin, Theophilus. Boola moorta kwabba-don. Baal boordak karni warrinya mili-milikal, mandang noolonga edjeniny ngalany kardakor.
Baalap boordak karni noolonga mili-milikal, moodlooka moorta warranga ngalany. Nidja-nidja moorta kwadja-djinang moodlooka alikwadjakang, kidji baalap warranga Warda-Kwabba.
Kidji ngarl, nganyang birdiyar, ngany kardjir mardayin-kaaditj moodlooka alikwadjakang. Ngany kaaditj nidja boorda kwabba, karni bardip mili-milikal boordakiny.
Ngany boordakiny ngarl noonook boorda-kaaditj moorart karnarny, moodlooka noonook kwadja-dwangka.
Djin-djin-kwabba waangki,
“John-Kakaloorniny boorda-koorlangweta”

Keny mammarap, baalang kol Zechariah, baal nyiny yakin-kooranyi birokal Herod nyiny Djelyib Judea-kang. Baal keny yakina-kooranyikang ngiyan yaka Abijah-kang. Elizabeth baalang koort-maat. Baalang moorta kardjir nyiny yakina-kooranyi.
Koodjal kwabba karra Boolanga-Yirakang miyalakal, moodlooka doniny Boolanga-Yirakang Warrinya waangki.
Koodjal koorlang-birt, narla Elizabeth yoowart kwadja-boodjari-biny. Baal wer Zechariah, koodjal karakor-djil.
Keny kedela, Zechariah, baal kwadja-yaka Maya-maya-Kooranyi-bwora, narla baalang kedela yakin-kooranyi yaakiny.
Yakina-kooranyi, baalap kalyakool banitja kooranyi boyara, djinanginy naatj mammarap boorda-narra manna-ngoonyang karla-kooranyal.
Ngarl Zachariah, baal bwora-koorl Boolanga-Yirakang Maya-maya-Kooranyi. Bandak, moorta boola baalap Boolanga-Yira kwadja-yanganiny narla manna-ngoonyang kwadja-narriny.
Boolanga-Yirakang djin-djin-kwabba, baal Zechariah-kany yoowal-koorl, kidji baal yaaka ngwoornmoorn karla-kooranyikang, kwabbarap manna-ngoonyang narrinyang.
Nginda Zechariah djinang djin-djin-kwabba, baal wayarn.

Yalga djin-djin-kwabba waangki baalany, “Yoowart wayarn, Zechariah! Boolanga-Yira baal noonany dwangkiny, moodlooka noonang koort-bwora. Elizabeth, noonang koort-maat, baal boorda boodjari-biny. Baal boorda yidja noonang nop. Noonook boorda-kolitj baalany ‘John’.
Noonook boorda djoorab-djoorab-biny, kidji warma moorta, baalap kardjir boorda koort-kwabba nginda baal koorlangweta!
“Baal boorda moorditj-biny Boolanga-Yirakang miyalakal. Baal yoowart djarnyak ngarn kepa-mardayin. Ngolanga doomboo, Kangya-Kooranyi boorda-moorartitj baalany,
kidji baal boorda karro-barrang boola moorta Israel-ang Birdiyarak, baalapang Boolanga-Yira.

“Baal boorda-koorl Birdiyar-koodjookat, mardayin-djil Elijah-mokiny, Boolanga-Yirakang Warda-Marridjiny. Baal boorda karro-barrang maamana wer koorlangka dandjo-dandjo. Baal boorda korang wara-wara moorta kwabba djoorootak, alidja djooroot-djin kwabba moorta yana, moorta ngiyan kaaditj karnarny. Baal boorda kakatar Boolanga-Yirakang moorta kwadjat Birdiyar yoowal-koorl.”
Zechariah baal waangki-djinang djin-djin-kwabba, “Yarn ngany boorda-kaaditj nginda noonang waangkiny boorda edjena? Ngany bworan, kidji nganyang koort-maat kardjir karbarli.”
“Ngany Gabriel,” djin-djin-kwabba waangk. “Ngany yaaka Boolanga-Yira-booram. Boolanga-Yira baal waangki-koorl nganyany noonak. Ngany djarnyak waangki noonany kidji barrang Warda-Kwabba noonak!

“Yalga noonook yoowart djinang-karni nganyang warrinya. Moodlooka boorda-edjena kwabba kedelakal. Narla noonook yoowart djinang-karni, noonook boorda dwangka-birt. Noonook yoowart boorda waangki kwadjat kedela nginda nganyang warrinya edjena.”
Yeyi moorta naan-yaaka Zechariah. Baalap wandaniny narla baal kwodjang Maya-maya-Kooranyi-bwora.
Nginda baal bandak-koorl, baal yoowart kayar-waangki, kidji ngarl baalap kaaditji Zechariah kwadja-djinang koondarm Maya-maya-Kooranyi bwora. Baal maar-waangki, yoowart waangkiny.
Ngolanga baalang kedelara yakiny Maya-maya-Kooranyi bwora, Zechariah wort-koorl baalang karlap.
Mila, baalang koort-maat, Elizabeth, boodjari-biny kidji baal naan-yaaka maya-maya-bwora maar mikara.
“Yeyi ngolanga kwodjang, Boolanga-Yira maar-yanga nganyany,” baal waangki. “Baal barnak wort-barrang nganyang karnya!”
Djin-djin-kwabba warranga Mary,
“Jesus boorda-koorlangweta”
Nginda Elizabeth boodjari maar-keny mikara, Boolanga-Yira waangki-koorl djin-djin-kwabba Gabriel Nazareth-ak, karlamaya Galilee-kal.
Baal barrang Boolanga-Yirakang warrinya mangak. Baalang ngoonoolong kwadja-yanga baalany Joseph-ang koort-maat-biny. Nidja mammarap djoowak Djelyib David-ang. Mangakang kol ‘Mary’.
Djin-djin-kwabba koorl Mary kidji waangki, “Nakal noonak! Boolanga-Yira nyiny noonookyel kidji baal moorditj yanga-kwabba noonak!”
Mary wayarn-djil, djin-djin-kwabba dwankiny, kidji baal waangki-djinang moodlooka baalang kaat-bwora.
Djin-djin-kwabba waangki baal, “Mary! Yoowart wayarn! Boolanga-Yira yanga-kwabba noonany.
Noonook boorda boodjari-biny kidji yidja nop, kidji noonook boorda-kolitj baalany ‘Jesus.’
Baal boorda moorditj. Baal boorda kolitj-yan ‘Boolanga-Yirakang Nop’. Boolanga-Yira waangki nidja. Baal boorda yira-yaaka Djelyib, baalang maam-inram David-mokiny.
Kidji baal boorda nyiny Djelyib djoowakang Jacob-ang kalyakool. Baalang Boodjer boorda-yaaka kalyakool!”
Mary waangki djin-djin-kwabba, “Ngany koolamata. Yarn nidja boorda edjena?”
Djin-djin-kwabba waangki, “Kangya-Kooranyi boorda-koorl noonak kidji Boolanga-Yirakang moorditj boorda yira-malitji noonook. Nidja kooranyi koorlang boorda kolitj-yan ‘Boolanga-Yirakang Nop’.
Noonook barrang-dwangka Elizabeth, noonang ngoonoolong? Moorta waangki nidja baal yoowart koorlang-yidja, yalga yeyi, baal boodjari maar-keny mikara - kidji baal kabarli.
Yoowart noolonga nyiny naatj Boolanga-Yira yoowart kayar don.”
“Ngany Boolanga-Yirakang yakin,” Mary waangki. “Nidja edjena-oola nganyak, moodlooka noonook waangki.” Djin-djin-kwabba wort-koorl baalany.
Mary koorl Elizabeth-ang maya-maya
Ngolanga, Mary kakatar kidji baal wort-koorl karlamaya kardakal Judea-kang.
Mary bwora-koorl Zechariah-ang maya-maya, kidji baal waangki-kwabba Elizabeth.
Elizabeth dwangka Mary-ang maaya, kidji yilak-yilak, baalang maawit marridja baalang doomboo-bwora.
Kangya-Kooranyi moorartitj Elizabeth, kidji baal woola, “Boolanga-Yira boola-djil yanga-kwabba noonook, kardakor mandang yokaman, kidji baal yanga-kwabba koorlang, keny noonook boorda yidja!
“Naadjil nidja moorditj noolong edjena nganyak, yeyi nganyang Birdiyarang ngaangk yoowal-koorl, yoowal-koorl djinangak nganyany?
Narla nginda noonook waangki-kwabba nganyany, ngany dwangka noonook, kidji nganyang koorlang ngany-bwora djoorabiny bardang.
Noonook djarnyak djoorab-djoorab, kaaditjiny Boolanga-Yirakang warrinya noonak boorda-edjena!”
Mary yanganan Boolanga-Yira
Mary waangki: “Nganyang koort yanganan Boolanga-Yira.

Yeyi moortaman, baalap boorda-waangki ngany djoorab,
narla Boolanga-Yira baal kwadja-don moorditj noolonga nganyang.
Baal ngorna-kwabba moortakak ngiyan woonya baalany kidji yaka baalang,
moorta djoowakang koora wer djoowakang yeyi.

Mary naan-yaaka mo mila Elizabeth-al, kidji ngolonga,

content: John-Kakaloorniny koorlangweta
Yeyi kedela koorl Elizabeth-ang maawitang. Baal yidja nop.
Elizabeth-ang ngoonoolonga wer baalang babina, baalap dwangka nidja warda. Boolanga-Yira moorditj yanga-kwabba Elizabeth, kidji baalap mandang djoorab-abiny Elizabeth-ang.
Ngolanga maar-koodjal kedela, moorta koorl maawitang kardjatinyang, alimarn Warriny waangki. Baalap koordook kolitjo baalany ‘Zechariah’, baalang maaman-mokiny.
Yalga baalang ngaangk waangki, “Yoowart! Baalang kol ‘John’.”
Ngarl baalap waangki baalany, “Yoowart noonookang ngoonoolonga kolitj-yan ‘John!”
Karro baalap maar-waangki baalang maamanak. Baalap waangki-djinang baalany naatj kol baal koordook yango baalang nop.
Zechariah ngakaka mili-mili kidji baal boordak, “Baalang kol ‘John’.” “Kai!” baalap mira.
Winidjinbar, Zechariah kayar waangki karro, kidji baal malyak Boolanga-Yirany yangananiny.
Moortaman wayarn-abiny, kidji nidja warda koorl mandang kardak boodjerang Judea-ang.
Nginda moortaman dwangka nidja warda, baalap malyak kaaditjiiny kidji waangki-djinanginy, “Naatj nidja koorlang boorda-don?” Moortaman, baalap djinang Boolanga-Yirang mardayin nyiny koorlangal.
Zechariah yanganan Boolanga-Yira
Kangya-Kooranyi yoowal-koorl Zechariah, John-ang maaman, kidji Kangya-Kooranyi moorartitj baalany. Zechariah waangki Boolanga-Yirakang Warda-Kwabba:

content.text: Boolanga-Yira kwadja-yanga ngalany baalang mardayin Nop.
Koora, baal warrin-yanga baalang Warda Marridjiny.
yoowart kayar-bakatj ngalany kidji yardjang ngalany.
Baal waangki nidja, baal boorda ngorna-kwabba ngalang maam-inramak,
kidji baal boorda barrang-dwangka baalang kooranyi warrinya,
Baal ngwidam waangki Abraham-ak, ngalang maam-inram.
Baal yanga baalang kooranyi warrin. Baal boorda
ngarl wara-wara moorta yoowart bakkan ngalany,
kidji ngarl ngala kayar-yaka Boolanga-Yirang, wayarn-birt.
Ngarl ngala boorda nyiny kooranyi wer kwabba-djil, Boolanga-Yira-booram,
Noonook boorda-koorl Birdiyar koodjookat kidji kakatar baalang djooroot,
kidji noonook boorda-warrang baalang moorta nidja:
Ngalang Boolanga-Yira yanga koort-kwabba kidji baal bedik-bedik.
Baal boorda barrang ngalang ngandabat, ngangk-mokiny yirabiny
nginda ngangk moonakiny Boolanga Yirang Boodjer-yen,
kidji baal boorda-barrang-yalgawa ngalang djena djoorootal nakalang.”

content: Koorlang kwabba-djil maladja, mardayan yarlinal wer kwoyalangal. John naan-yaaka kwangkanal kwadjat kedela nginda baal barnak koorl moortakak Israel-ang.
